table.retrieve:
SELECT
	AliasName=IT.customicode,
	IT.icode, 
	IT.ManfCode,
	Item=IT.name,
	Manufacturer=(SELECT MANF.name FROM Manufacturer MANF WHERE MANF.ManfCode = IT.ManfCode),
	ItemCategory=(SELECT CAT.name FROM ItemCategory CAT WHERE CAT.ICatCode = IT.ICatCode),
	ItemClass=(SELECT CLS.name FROM ItemClass CLS WHERE CLS.ICCode = IT.ICCode),
	ItemPacking=(SELECT IP.name FROM ItemPacking IP WHERE IP.PackCode = IT.PackCode),
	genericitem=(SELECT genericitem.name FROM genericitem WHERE genericitem.genericCode = IT.genericCode),
	IT.packunits,
	IT.purPrice,  
	IT.minqty,
	SoldQty = ISNULL(SUM(SL.SoldQty), 0),
	ReturnQty = ISNULL(SUM(SL.ReturnQty), 0),
	Stock = ISNULL((SELECT Stock=ISNULL(SUM(GD.CurrQty),0) 
		FROM Godowndetail GD WHERE IT.ICode = GD.ICode AND GD.GCode IN (SELECT G.Gcode FROM Godown G WHERE G.ConsiderStockInPO='Y')), 0),
	TransitStock = ISNULL(IT.transitstock, 0),
	IT.PurOrderBasePeriodDays, 
	IT.PurOrderProjPeriodDays, 
	IT.POPolicyCode,
	IT.StartDate,
	IT.EndDate,
	LastPurInvCode = MAX(PUR.PurInvCode),
	LastPurDate = MAX(PUR.Date),
	gstperc=IT.gstperc1,
	packsalestax=IT.packsalestax,
	saleprice=IT.saleprice,
	rpp=IT.recentpurprice,
	packavgprice=ROUND(IT.avgprice * IT.packunits, 2)
FROM 
	(SELECT I.Icode, I.CustomICode, I.Name, I.MinQty, I.PackUnits, I.PurPrice, I.TransitStock, I.ManfCode, I.ICatCode, I.ICCode, I.PackCode, I.Active, M.PurOrderBasePeriodDays, M.PurOrderProjPeriodDays, M.POPolicyCode,
			StartDate=DATEADD(DAY, - M.PurOrderBasePeriodDays, :ad_baseperiodenddate),
			EndDate=:ad_baseperiodenddate, I.GenericCode,
			I.gstperc1, I.packsalestax, i.saleprice, i.avgprice, i.recentpurprice
	FROM Item I, Manufacturer M
	WHERE 	I.Active=1 AND I.GeneratePO = 'Y' AND
			I.ManfCode IN
			(SELECT ManfCode 
			FROM Manufacturer
			WHERE
				ManufacturerTypeCode IN (:ai_manftypecode) AND
				POPolicyCode IN 
					(SELECT DISTINCT CP.POPolicyCode 
					FROM POPolicy CP, POPolicyDetail CPD
					WHERE 
						CP.POPolicyCode = CPD.POPolicyCode AND
						CPD.WeekDayCode = DatePart(weekday, :ad_orderdate) AND
						CPD.WeekOfMonth IN (SELECT WeekOfMonth=DBO.Fn_WeekDayCountInMonth(:ad_orderdate)))) AND
		I.ManfCode = M.ManfCode) IT
	LEFT OUTER JOIN
	(SELECT I.Icode, SoldQty = SUM(SD.LooseQty), ReturnQty = 0
	FROM 
		(SELECT I.Icode, M.PurOrderBasePeriodDays, M.PurOrderProjPeriodDays, POPolicyCode,
			StartDate=DATEADD(DAY, - M.PurOrderBasePeriodDays, :ad_baseperiodenddate),
			EndDate=:ad_baseperiodenddate
		FROM Item I, Manufacturer M
		WHERE
			I.Active=1 AND I.GeneratePO = 'Y' AND
			I.ManfCode IN 
				(SELECT ManfCode FROM Manufacturer
				WHERE 	
					ManufacturerTypeCode IN (:ai_manftypecode) AND
					POPolicyCode IN 
					(SELECT DISTINCT CP.POPolicyCode 
					FROM POPolicy CP, POPolicyDetail CPD
					WHERE CP.POPolicyCode = CPD.POPolicyCode AND
						CPD.WeekDayCode = DatePart(weekday, :ad_orderdate) AND
						CPD.WeekOfMonth IN (SELECT WeekOfMonth=DBO.Fn_WeekDayCountInMonth(:ad_orderdate)))) AND
			I.ManfCode = M.ManfCode) I,
		Saledetail SD, SaleLedger SL
	WHERE
		SL.ConsiderInPO = 'Y' AND
		I.ICode = SD.ICode AND 
		SD.SaleInvCode = SL.SaleInvcode AND
		SL.Date BETWEEN I.StartDate AND I.EndDate
	GROUP BY I.ICode
	UNION ALL
	SELECT I.Icode,	SoldQty = 0, ReturnQty = SUM(SD.LooseQty)
	FROM SRDetail SD, SRLedger SL, 
		(SELECT I.Icode, M.PurOrderBasePeriodDays, M.PurOrderProjPeriodDays, POPolicyCode,
			StartDate=DATEADD(DAY, - M.PurOrderBasePeriodDays, :ad_baseperiodenddate),
			EndDate=:ad_baseperiodenddate
		FROM Item I, Manufacturer M
		WHERE
			I.Active=1 AND I.GeneratePO = 'Y' AND
			I.ManfCode IN 
				(SELECT ManfCode FROM Manufacturer
				WHERE 
					ManufacturerTypeCode IN (:ai_manftypecode) AND
					POPolicyCode IN 
					(SELECT DISTINCT CP.POPolicyCode 
					FROM POPolicy CP, POPolicyDetail CPD
					WHERE CP.POPolicyCode = CPD.POPolicyCode AND
						CPD.WeekDayCode = DatePart(weekday, :ad_orderdate) AND
						CPD.WeekOfMonth IN (SELECT WeekOfMonth=DBO.Fn_WeekDayCountInMonth(:ad_orderdate)))) AND
			I.ManfCode = M.ManfCode) I
	WHERE
		SL.ConsiderInPO = 'Y' AND
		SD.ICode = I.ICode AND
		SL.SRInvCode = SD.SRInvcode AND
		SL.Date BETWEEN I.StartDate AND I.EndDate
	GROUP BY I.ICode
	UNION ALL
	SELECT I.Icode, SoldQty = SUM(SD.SaleQty), ReturnQty = SUM(SD.ReturnQty)
	FROM 
		(SELECT I.Icode, M.PurOrderBasePeriodDays, M.PurOrderProjPeriodDays, POPolicyCode,
			StartDate=DATEADD(DAY, - M.PurOrderBasePeriodDays, :ad_baseperiodenddate),
			EndDate=:ad_baseperiodenddate
		FROM Item I, Manufacturer M
		WHERE
			I.Active=1 AND I.GeneratePO = 'Y' AND
			I.ManfCode IN 
				(SELECT ManfCode FROM Manufacturer
				WHERE ManufacturerTypeCode IN (:ai_manftypecode) AND
					POPolicyCode IN 
					(SELECT DISTINCT CP.POPolicyCode 
					FROM POPolicy CP, POPolicyDetail CPD
					WHERE CP.POPolicyCode = CPD.POPolicyCode AND
						CPD.WeekDayCode = DatePart(weekday, :ad_orderdate) AND
						CPD.WeekOfMonth IN (SELECT WeekOfMonth=DBO.Fn_WeekDayCountInMonth(:ad_orderdate)))) AND
			I.ManfCode = M.ManfCode) I,
		PreviousSaleHistory SD
	WHERE
	   	I.ICode = SD.ICode AND 
		SD.Date BETWEEN I.StartDate AND I.EndDate
	GROUP BY I.ICode) AS SL ON (IT.ICode = SL.ICode)
	LEFT OUTER JOIN
	(SELECT I.Icode, PurInvCode=MAX(P.PurInvCode), Date=MAX(P.Date)
	FROM Item I, Manufacturer M, PurLedger P, PurDetail D
	WHERE 	dbo.Fn_GetPreference('fetchlastpurinfoinpo')='Y' AND
		I.Active=1 AND I.GeneratePO = 'Y' AND
			I.ManfCode IN
			(SELECT ManfCode 
			FROM Manufacturer
			WHERE ManufacturerTypeCode IN (:ai_manftypecode) AND
				POPolicyCode IN 
					(SELECT DISTINCT CP.POPolicyCode 
					FROM POPolicy CP, POPolicyDetail CPD
					WHERE 
						CP.POPolicyCode = CPD.POPolicyCode AND
						CPD.WeekDayCode = DatePart(weekday, :ad_orderdate) AND
						CPD.WeekOfMonth IN (SELECT WeekOfMonth=DBO.Fn_WeekDayCountInMonth(:ad_orderdate)))) AND
		I.ManfCode = M.ManfCode AND
		P.Posted = 'Y' AND
		I.ICode = D.ICode AND
		D.PurInvCode = P.PurInvCode
	GROUP BY I.Icode) AS Pur ON (IT.ICode = PUR.ICode)
GROUP BY
	IT.icode,
	IT.ManfCode,
	IT.Name,
	IT.customicode,
	IT.ManfCode,
	IT.ICatCode,
	IT.ICCode,
	IT.PackCode,
	IT.GenericCode,
	IT.PackUnits,
	IT.purprice,
	IT.saleprice,
	IT.AvgPrice,
	IT.RecentPurPrice,
	IT.minqty,
	IT.transitstock,
	IT.PurOrderBasePeriodDays, 
	IT.PurOrderProjPeriodDays, 
	IT.POPolicyCode,
	IT.StartDate,
	IT.EndDate,
	IT.gstperc1,
	IT.packsalestax
ORDER BY
	Manufacturer,
	ItemCategory,
	ItemClass,
	ItemPacking,
	IT.Name
